messages:
Maya K: Quick async — HorizonPay renewal: CS reported webhook retries and 5xx spikes overnight. Sharing logs and pinging eng-oncall.
Liam C: Thanks. Did CS open a ticket? Any deploys scheduled last night?
Maya K: Yep ticket created (#4021). No intentional deploys from our side. Snippet from the delivery logs is below.
Maya K: ```\n2026-02-18T03:12:08Z ERROR webhook deliver status=504 duration_ms=12034 tenant=horizonpay endpoint=/v1/webhook/receive
2026-02-18T03:12:09Z WARN  retry attempt=1 status=504
2026-02-18T03:12:10Z INFO  queue_latency_ms=820 model=embedder-v2
``` 
Eng-Oncall: Saw the alert. Investigating proxy timeouts between rdp-gw and router. Temporarily increasing proxy timeouts and routing small payloads to a lightweight model. Is HorizonPay Hosted or Dedicated?
Anya P: HorizonPay is on Dedicated (reserved pool). Renewal meeting is Friday — CS is sensitive to outages.
Jorge R: If dedicated, could be queueing on the pool. I'll check GPU pool health and autoscaler events now.
Eng-Oncall: FYI I applied a canary fallback route to model-quant-lite for webhook endpoints to reduce per-request latency.
Sam T: CS reports failures mostly for payloads >50KB. Could be timeouts during larger batch processing.
Maya K: Blocker: renewal risk if this repeats. Can someone call ETA on mitigation so I can update the customer?
Liam C: Immediate mitigation = increased proxy timeout + canary route. Jorge — if autoscale can add capacity in ~10-15m we should be good. I'll coordinate if more aggressive scaling needed.
Jorge R: Autoscaler did attempt scale; one node failed to join due to expired kubelet certs. Restarted the node; it's rejoining. ETA ~12m.
Anya P: I'll draft a customer message: "We're actively investigating; mitigation applied; expect improved delivery in ~15 minutes." Good to send?
Maya K: Yes send that. Keep wording high-level, no infra details.
Eng-Oncall: Monitoring: success rate climbing from 86% -> 98% over the last 7m after node restart and canary routing. Keeping an eye on tail latency.
Sam T: Please capture this window in the renewal brief for Sales — timeframe and customer impact.
CS Bot: Incident #4021 updated — status=mitigated; impact=webhook retries for HorizonPay; window=03:05-03:20 UTC; owners=Eng-Oncall, Jorge R.
Maya K: Closing loop here — I'll update renewal owner and ask for a short postmortem tomorrow AM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
